Documentation → Getting Started → Documentation on the node

The documentation on your node — no internet needed

Every SATOM node serves this Documentation Center and the reference manual itself, at /manual/, so the documentation opens from the sign-in page even on a network with no internet access.

👤 ForViewerOperatorAdministrator
📍 WhereSign-in page → Documentation (URL /manual/) · Sign-in page → API documentation (URL /manual/docs/api.html) · Concept Map → Documentation Center

What is it?#

SATOM is often installed on a management network that cannot reach the internet. The documentation therefore travels with the product: every node serves this Documentation Center and the reference manual itself, under /manual/. The Documentation link on the sign-in page opens it from the node you are on, whether or not that network can reach the public site.

What does it do?#

Address on the node What opens
/manual/ (same as /manual/docs-center/) This Documentation Center: articles by category, learning paths, search
/manual/docs/<name>.html A reference page: user guide, installation, API, command line…
/manual/docs.html The reference hub
  • Documentation, under the sign-in form, opens the Documentation Center.
  • API documentation, under the sign-in form, and How this works on the AI Advisor page open their reference pages.
  • All of these open the copy on the node. The public site is used only for a page this installation does not carry.
  • The copy matches the version installed: each release ships the documentation it was built with, in the offline bundles, the update packages and the container image alike.

Requirements#

None. It works on every node, including standby nodes and container installations.

Permissions#

No sign-in is needed: the person who cannot sign in is often the one who needs the documentation. Signed-in users reach it from any ADOM. What is served is the same public documentation published on the product site, without the internal category.

How to use#

Open the documentation#

  1. Open the sign-in page of any SATOM node.
  2. Click Documentation (under the sign-in form). The Documentation Center opens in a new tab.
  3. Use the search box, the categories on the left or the learning paths on the home page.

From inside the console, search the Concept Map for documentation or manual: it lists Documentation Center.

Share a link#

Copy the address from the browser. It points at the node, for example https://<your node>/manual/docs-center/certificates.html, so a colleague on the same network opens it without internet access.

Troubleshooting#

Symptom Cause What to do
Documentation opens the public site instead of the node The installation predates the documentation on the node, or its tree is incomplete Update SATOM (Software Update); the next release carries the copy
A page answers 404 under /manual/ Only the published pages are served: the README files, Markdown sources and anything outside the two documentation directories are not Open the page from the Documentation Center's navigation or search
The text uses a different font than the public site The node loads nothing from the internet, so the public site's web font is not fetched Nothing — the system font is used on purpose
An article you just edited does not show on the node The node serves the copy of its release; the Documentation Center is rebuilt into each release It appears after the next update
